_comment: Appointments row settings (owner request 2026-10-17). callsBeforeBookingDays: 'Calls per booking' counts the host rep's outbound dials to the booked contact in this many days before the booking was created. showRateLeaderMinMarked: a rep needs at least this many appointments marked Showed or No-show before they can be the show-rate leader (so one lucky 1-of-1 does not win). ngtStage: the Veteran pipeline stage read as 'Appointment Booked (NGT)' for the appointment→outcome and NGT follow-up sections; its id must exist in config/ghl-mapping.json. outcomeMilestones: the tracked milestone keys that count as a conversion after an appointment (CA 101 submitted first, then IAU App Submitted for every tracked semester: FS2, Spring Session 1); NGT entries are read from the stage history instead.
